run_play_vs_agent_human: run play_vs_agent as a human host with a specified map and remote agent IP
run_play_vs_agent_agent: run play_vs_agent as an agent connecting to a human-hosted game on a remote host
build_lan_sc2_game: build a LAN StarCraft II game between a human player and a custom agent via SSH tunnel
test_play_vs_agent_render: test play_vs_agent with pygame rendering enabled and custom feature layer resolutions
review_play_vs_agent_entry_point: review the play_vs_agent entry point and main function that dispatches to human or agent mode
